Are you an experienced order picker looking for a new challenge in logistics? Then we have a great opportunity for you.

As an orderpicker with forklift or reachtruck experience, you are responsible for collecting and processing orders using a hand scanner. You will operate an EPT on a daily basis and ensure that orders are picked accurately, completed on time, and prepared for shipment. In addition, you will check incoming and outgoing goods, keep warehouse locations organised, and support the smooth flow of logistics operations.

Do you have experience operating a forklift or reach truck? Then you will have the opportunity to use these skills when moving goods and pallets throughout the warehouse. You will work with modern warehouse management systems, ensuring inventory and logistics processes are accurately recorded. Your attention to detail and sense of responsibility help maintain efficient operations and excellent customer service.

You will work in different warehouse zones, including chilled areas and freezer sections with temperatures of up to -15°C. You are comfortable working in a temperature-controlled environment where quality, speed, and food safety are essential. Of course, professional protective clothing will be provided to ensure you can work safely and comfortably.

Working hours take place between 07:00 and 00:00. You will join a dedicated team where teamwork, reliability, and a positive attitude are highly valued. Your contribution plays an important role in keeping the logistics operation running efficiently.

Ready for a new challenge in logistics? Apply now and discover what this opportunity can offer you.

- Good command of Dutch and/or English
- Experience with order picking using a hand scanner and EPT is required
- Experience operating a forklift and/or reach truck is an advantage
- You work accurately, safely, and have a strong focus on quality
- You are a team player and comfortable working in chilled and frozen environments

The best part? You’ll drive brand-new cars all day long, and you get to decide for the most part when you work. It’s ideal if you want to balance your job with school, hobbies, sports, or your family.

Do you love cars, enjoy being on the go, and are you looking for flexible work? Then CLDN is the perfect place for you.

What do we ask?
Would you like to work as a car transporter? If so, here’s what we’re looking for:

- 18 years of age or older
- Fluent in Dutch or English
- Must have held a Class B (European) driver’s license for at least 1 year
- Own transportation
- No problem applying for a Certificate of Good Conduct (VOG)
- Available to work between 8 and 40 hours per week
- Flexibility
